review_method: Candidate-aware direct viewing of both complete 1224x1584 original-resolution PNGs, compared row by row to SOURCE_QA and Markdown; original PDF bytes read and both full-page pixel buffers replayed; root structural verifier invoked once. No new crops were required.

findings.statement: All physical rows are preserved: page 1 has 45 and page 2 has 43; 69 fee rows, 4 continuations, 7 section headings, 4 subheadings, 3 notes and 1 column header.
findings.limitation: These are document-table counts, not legal-requirement counts or geographic completeness.

findings.statement: Three $5,000 Deposit; Refund/Charge will apply rows remain continuations of Activity Permit*, Area Permit and Munic. and Indust. Water Project*. Actual Cost is separately retained.
findings.limitation: Blank application cells are not missing service labels; no total or final fee calculation.

findings.statement: The $210 ea. for Lighting, Parking & Buffering Plans continuation belongs to Site Development Plan - Nonresidential, whose preceding fee is $630.
findings.limitation: No alternative or cumulative fee interpretation added.

findings.statement: The first five page-2 rows visibly continue Land Division Applications from page 1. Their star/caret marks and fee amounts remain distinct.
findings.limitation: Reading-order context is preserved without claiming legal applicability.

findings.statement: All three Fire Fees rows carry $1,200 per Undeveloped Lot and the dagger note: $600 due prior to plat recordation, $600 due at time of building permit. Park and School sections remain separate.
findings.limitation: Timing terms are source text, not independently verified current charges or a jurisdictional assignment to a particular district.

findings.statement: Certificates^ is a marked group heading above Conforming Use, Merger by Contiguity, Parcel of Record and Certificate of Nonconformance; each shows $55. The caret context points to the recording-fee note.
findings.limitation: The four child labels do not acquire invented literal caret characters or a calculated recording charge.

findings.statement: The exact bottom notes are *application will also require Advertising Fee. and ^application will also require Recording Fee(s). They are global marker notes, detached from Appeals.
findings.limitation: No advertised fee is silently added to an unmarked row.

findings.statement: The source says documents reviewing incomplete applications within the Resubmittal Review Fee label; $75/hr. is aligned with the full two-line label. Both trailing source-line spaces remain in native evidence.
findings.limitation: Do not repair the awkward wording or infer a different trigger.

findings.statement: No Charge, Actual Cost, $90 + $300/lot, $90 + $300/developable lot and Similar Use Determination*/Director's Interpretation remain exact distinct strings.
findings.limitation: No currency/unit normalization, arithmetic, or punctuation-codepoint certification beyond retained native bytes.

findings.statement: Both supplied PNGs equal an independent 144dpi PyMuPDF replay of the retained two-page original at the pixel level; native re-extraction and all structural bindings pass.
findings.limitation: Pixel equality verifies representation linkage, not legal effect. Review is Atlas candidate-aware, after root annotations, not a blind pass.

findings.statement: The exact A031 browser DOM anchor links the county planning page to the retained PDF URL. Recorded SH-EXT-002 custody has one 200 PDF and one 403 commissioner catalog, two URLs and 81,082 bytes.
findings.limitation: A031 is a browser DOM derivative; HTTP/time evidence is received Sherlock evidence, not an independent Atlas acquisition. The 403 body is not a successful catalog or adopting instrument.

findings.statement: The filename/anchor advertises Adopted 5.8.25. HTTP Last-Modified says 14 May 2025; PDF metadata carries a 14 May 2025 creation/modification time and title Suggested Fee Schedule FINAL.xlsx.
findings.limitation: None is an independently established adoption/effective date; neither Suggested nor FINAL alone determines legal status. No issuer/date/execution heading appears on the two page faces.

findings.statement: No exact fee URL or PDF digest match was found in the hash-verified 1,415-row pinned selected legacy stream.
findings.limitation: This does not establish absence in current global manifests, renamed URLs, other representations, or the source corpus.
